sloka: निवेशयत मे सैन्यम् अभिप्रायेण सर्वशः ।विश्रान्तः प्रतरिष्यामः श्वैदानीम् महा नदीम् ॥२-८३-२३॥
transliteration: niveśayata me sainyam abhiprāyeṇa sarvaśaḥ ।viśrāntaḥ pratariṣyāmaḥ śvaidānīm mahā nadīm ॥2-83-23॥

translations.english: You may, according to your convenience, halt the army anywhere here and, after taking rest (for the night), we shall cross the river Ganga tomorrow.
